title: Give OLY-4-03 a neighboring-case check and record its mechanism
summary: Add a small pure check in athena-core verify.rs that, for a fix touching navigation, reports which neighboring cases (nested navigation, browser history, direct links, interrupted flows) its added tests do not cover. Record it as OLY-4-03's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, with a test that fails without it. Audience: Ares/Apollo and the verifier judging fixes.

defaults_applied.how: Test plus fmt, clippy, test pass.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs (pure helpers such as is_test_path, finding_is_content_only, with a tests module at the end) and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (labels like producers). Entry point for the new code is verify.rs next to judge; it does no probing or resolution and adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched; the property is measured directly by the function over test text.
Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs and docs/spec.toml, both already present; neighbouring requirements OLY-4-01/02 use the same mechanism/measure format.

Goal is a real, minimal mechanism; wiring it as a blocking verdict rule is not required, so it is a helper plus test, with measure `status: not shown` and the test name unless a status label is added.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) are unchanged; CHANGELOG.md is only optionally touched.

acceptance_criteria.text: In docs/spec.toml, requirement OLY-4-03 has a mechanism other than "none" that names the new function in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs, keeps owner "Ares", and its measure ends with `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name that shows it.

verify.rs defines a pure function that, given the added test text of a navigation-related fix, returns the neighboring cases (nested navigation, browser history, direct links, interrupted flows) that no test covers; Grep finds it and it is reachable from non-test code or is named in the mechanism.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core neighbor`: the new test asserts a fix whose tests cover only the direct case reports all four missing, and one covering all four reports none; the test fails when the function body is reverted to return an empty list.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass.

Outcome-check: the spec measure states how neighboring-case coverage is shown, so a reader of docs/spec.toml can find the test that demonstrates it; the change adds no refusal rule to the gate and changes no verdict for existing jobs.

out_of_scope: Making the check a blocking verdict rule or changing prompts
